coverage.rule: A value from a row whose coverage is under 50% is withheld: null, with a reason next to it.

provenance.definition: Pipeline data-quality checks: hours in fail and warn per check, hours with no service left out
sql: with t as (select check_name, status, (cast(service_date as timestamp) + to_hours(hour_local + case when hour_local < 3 then 24 else 0 end)) at time zone 'America/New_York' as hour_start from read_parquet('/Users/akshay/projects/headway/tests/fixtures/gold_snapshot/gold/agg_quality_checks_hourly.parquet')), w as (select * from t where hour_start > (select max(hour_start) from t) - to_hours(24)) select check_name, count(*) filter (where status in ('ok', 'warn', 'fail')) as n_hours_evaluated, count(*) filter (where status = 'fail') as n_fail_hours, count(*) filter (where status = 'warn') as n_warn_hours, count(*) filter (where status = 'ok') as n_ok_hours, case when count(*) filter (where status = 'fail') > 0 then 'fail' when count(*) filter (where status = 'warn') > 0 then 'warn' when count(*) filter (where status = 'ok') > 0 then 'ok' else 'not_evaluated' end as worst_status from w group by check_name order by check_name limit 501
